title: GitHub Enterprise credential inventory exports
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub Enterprise owners can export an inventory of SSH keys, PATs, OAuth tokens, and GitHub App tokens, with owner, scope, date, target, and audit-log correlation fields.
actionable_takeaway: Build a credential inventory review loop before incident response, not after a token leak.

title: Grok 4.7 is available in GitHub Copilot
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Grok 4.7 is rolling out to Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise across IDE, CLI, cloud agent, app, JetBrains, Xcode, and Eclipse surfaces, billed at provider list pricing.
actionable_takeaway: Treat every new model-picker entry as a policy and cost event; confirm admin enablement and billing before pilots.

title: Copilot CLI 1.0.88-1
author: GitHub Copilot CLI Releases
why_it_matters: Copilot CLI 1.0.88-1 preserves /allow-all during managed-settings refresh failures, records exact approvals for missing paths without granting the parent directory, and explains sandboxed network denials from proxy tunnel failures.
actionable_takeaway: In CLI agent receipts, distinguish exact path grants from parent-directory grants and record network-denial bypass guidance.

title: Copilot CLI 1.0.87 stable
author: GitHub Copilot CLI Releases
why_it_matters: Copilot CLI 1.0.87 adds Auto routing startup defaults and org policy controls, recallable pending prompts, worktreePathTemplate, task forking during active turns, and more explicit session deletion behavior.
actionable_takeaway: Split prompt queue, worktree creation, auto routing, and session deletion into separate, reviewable operating receipts.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.157.0-alpha.2
author: OpenAI / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Codex alpha moved into the 0.157.0 line on 2026-09-21, while the latest stable release remains 0.155.1; alpha release bodies are sparse and need disposable-workspace testing before use.
actionable_takeaway: Keep 0.157 alpha as an observation lane and anchor production behavior on 0.155.1 until a specific fix justifies smoke testing.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.155.1 stable
author: OpenAI / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Codex 0.155.1 restores the local TUI default to disable reasoning summaries, avoiding provider request rejection when a provider does not support summary fields while respecting explicit settings.
actionable_takeaway: Add provider-capability preflight before enabling reasoning summaries, especially in mixed-provider or gateway setups.

title: ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.251 Codex updates
author: OpenAI Codex Changelog
why_it_matters: The Codex changelog reports iOS 1.2026.251 improvements around task detail layout, queued prompt display, and remembering the previously selected worktree mode for new tasks.
actionable_takeaway: Let iPhone handle dispatch and status checks, but keep Mac/Codex as the final evidence gate for file, test, commit, push, and deploy.

title: Upcoming Copilot model deprecations
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Selected Copilot models, including GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3.7 Flash, and Grok 4.5, are scheduled for deprecation on 2026-10-19 with suggested replacements.
actionable_takeaway: Create a dated model migration board for prompts, agents, policies, fixtures, and fallback models before 2026-10-19.

title: OpenAI Node 7.20.0
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: OpenAI Node 7.20.0 adds environment-variable vault credentials, external storage configuration management, safety case retrieval, safety warning/deactivation webhook events, and SIP media security fields.
actionable_takeaway: Treat SDK upgrades as operations-surface changes that need owner, permission, environment, and readback records.

title: OpenAI Python 3.16.2
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: OpenAI Python 3.16.2 fixes a parse_response memory leak caused by TextFormatT parameterization, following 3.16.0 webhook endpoint management additions.
actionable_takeaway: Include parser memory behavior and webhook endpoint management in Python SDK upgrade smoke tests.

title: OpenAI Agents Python 0.22.3
author: OpenAI / Agents SDK
why_it_matters: Agents Python 0.22.3 fixes conditional approvals, server-managed resume output, async SQLite startup, tracing API-key caching, AdvancedSQLiteSession tool usage, subprocess reaping, and Unix-local execution docs.
actionable_takeaway: Add approval, resume, SQLite concurrency, tool-usage ledger, and subprocess cleanup to runtime smoke fixtures.

title: Claude Code 2.1.278
author: Anthropic / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Claude Code 2.1.278 defaults auto mode to the server-side classifier for several provider paths, adds a status row for classifier location, and warns on billed fallback.
actionable_takeaway: When comparing agents, record classifier location, opt-out switch, and billed fallback before attributing cost or latency to the model.
